artifact: B2a bulk ATAC FASTQ->BAM real-data validation
summary: End-to-end validation of the new raw-FASTQ entry point for bulk ATAC (aria/scripts/atac_align.py) on real ENCODE ATAC reads. atac_align ran the full bwa-mem2 -> fixmate -m -> samtools markdup -r -> ENCODE ATAC filter -> index pipeline on real paired reads, produced a valid filtered BAM with sensible alignment metrics, and the resulting BAM was consumed downstream by MACS3 peak calling. Confirms the plumbing and the aligner/filter parameters end-to-end.

validates: atac_align.py runs the real bwa-mem2 + samtools pipeline end-to-end (index build, alignment, fixmate, markdup, ATAC filter, index)
produces a samtools-quickcheck-valid coordinate-sorted filtered BAM
alignment QC metrics (pct_mapped, pct_dup, pct_mito, n_final) are computed from real flagstat/idxstats
the filtered BAM is consumed downstream (MACS3 BAMPE peak calling)
the documented aria-atacseq-env (bwa-mem2 + samtools) installs and runs
does_not_validate: this is NOT a sensitivity/recall benchmark of peak calling or DA (those are covered by the synthetic DA recovery gate and V47)

pct_dup and pct_mito are ~0 here because the input reads were re-derived from an already-processed ENCODE BAM (deduplicated) and restricted to chr20 (no chrM); a raw library would show real duplicate/mito fractions
alignment was to chr20 only (a tractable real-genome subset), not the whole genome

input.reads_origin: Real ENCODE K562 bulk ATAC reads (ENCFF512VEZ, rep1), extracted for chr20 via `samtools view chr20 | samtools collate | samtools fastq` into paired FASTQ. Real sequences/qualities from a real ATAC experiment; library was already ENCODE-processed.
input.reference: GRCh38.primary_assembly chr20 (UCSC chr-prefixed, matches the ENCODE BAM contigs)

findings.doc_accuracy_fix: Real validation surfaced that the -F 1804 filter (canonical ENCODE value) does NOT exclude supplementary alignments (0x800); 99/1,163,757 supplementary reads remained. The atac_align docstring/comment overstated this ('drop ... supplementary'); corrected to match ENCODE behavior. No behavior change (1804 is the ENCODE standard).
findings.biological_sanity: Peaks fall in expected accessible chr20 loci; this is a plumbing+aligner check, not a TF/biology claim.

provenance.determinism_note: bwa-mem2 alignment is deterministic for fixed threads/input; multi-thread record ordering can vary but the filtered read set and metrics are stable.

compute.note: bwa-mem2 chr20 index build is light; whole-genome index needs ~tens of GB RAM
